note: A CLAIM ABOUT THE TEST'S INSTRUMENT, NOT ABOUT THE OBJECT, and named as such because that is a different kind of claim from every other set in this file's directory.  `t_vpcmguard.c` asserts that all five `VPcmV34*` entry points are ABSENT from its own binary, and finding F985 records that the first version of that assertion returned five wrong answers: with a PLAIN declaration GCC folds `f == 0` to false at compile time, because a function's address is never null, so the file reported all five PRESENT in a process that had just aborted on their absence.  It cost a run.  The `__attribute__((weak))` on the declaration is what makes the comparison a comparison, and this is the mutation that pins it.  Finding F1004.

IT CANNOT BE ENCODED ON THE HEADER, which is where it was looked for first.  `include/dsplib/vpcm.h` only supplies an EMPTY fallback for `DSPLIB_VPCM_UNWRITTEN`; the attribute itself comes from the `#define` each comparing or calling translation unit makes before the include.  Forcing the header to override both -- `#undef` then an empty `#define` -- strips the attribute from `vpcm.c` as well, which turns `vpcm.o`'s five references into strong undefined ones and t_vpcmguard stops LINKING.  That is `did not compile`, which mutate.py counts as unusable and which does not fail a run (finding F347) -- a mutation that pins nothing while looking like one that does.  Measured, not assumed.

label: the comparing translation unit declares the five plain, not weak
why: ALL FIVE ARE NOW DEFINED (finding F7606: 'all seven are written'), which this suite's own test asserts at t_vpcmguard.c:238-246 ('all five VPcmV34* entry points are WRITTEN'). A function's address is never a null pointer in C, and GCC applies that rule at compile time for a PLAIN declaration while a WEAK one keeps it a real runtime load (F985/F1004) -- but the two readings diverge only when the symbol could actually resolve to zero. Since every one of the five has a real definition linked into this binary (src/pump/v34/v34pcmmain.cpp etc.), the runtime-loaded weak comparison and the compile-time-folded plain one both evaluate to nonzero/true on every build this suite can produce. No input distinguishes them any more; F7606 already measured this mutation as NOT caught after the rewrite and identical to its prior verdict.
